segments.sn45.19:1.3: Katamaṃ nu kho, āvuso, brahmacariyaṃ, katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosāna”nti?
segments.sn45.19:1.5: Bhaddako kho te, āvuso bhadda, ummaṅgo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
segments.sn45.19:1.8: Katamaṃ nu kho, āvuso, brahmacariyaṃ, katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosāna’”nti?
segments.sn45.19:1.10: “Ayameva kho, āvuso, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṃ, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.sn45.19:1.12: Yo kho, āvuso, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo –

lines: Evañhi tvaṃ āvusoti idaṃ tassa pucchāpatiṭṭhāpanatthāya āha.
